source: 666 New Information
target: 666 Nova Notitia

source: Lumian had rarely seen Penitent Baynfel act so abnormally.
target: Lumian Penitentem Baynfel rarissime vidit tam insolenter se gerere.

source: He asked with anticipation and curiosity, “What have you discovered?”
target: Interrogavit cum exspectatione et curiositate: “Quid invenisti?”

source: Baynfel, clad in a clergyman’s black robe, his charred body partially tainted by black flames, averted his gaze and replied in a deep voice, “The night conceals the flowing sin.”
target: Baynfel, indutus veste sacerdotali nigra, cuius corpus partim atris flammis combustum esset, oculos avertit et voce profunda respondit: “Nox fluitantem peccatum celat.”

source: With that, the Penitent stepped into the void and vanished from the room.
target: His verbis, Penitens in vacuum processit et ex conclavi evanuit.

source: The night conceals the flowing sin…
target: Nox fluitantem peccatum celat…

source: It’s emphasizing the night because that allows entry into the special dream?
target: Extollit noctem, quoniam id ingressum in somnium speciale concedit?

source: What does the ‘flowing sin’ refer to?
target: Ad quid refert “peccatum fluitans”?

source: Can’t you mysterious types speak plainly?
target: Num potestis, o vos mysteriosi, apertē loqui?

source: Lumian criticized, then opened Franca’s letter and quickly read it.
target: Lumian reprehendit, deinde epistolam Francae aperuit et celeriter legit.

source: To be honest, after such a long time, his desire to understand the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s past had significantly diminished.
target: Sinceriter, post tam longum tempus, cupiditas eius ad intellegendum praeteritum Artifacti Humanoidi Sigillati valde decrevit.

source: After all, he had mainly felt the other party’s state was similar to his own, triggering his emotions back then.
target: Nam plerumque sensit statum alterius similem suo esse, quod tum affectus eius excitavit.

source: That was why he had suggested it.
target: Idcirco id proposuerat.

source: Now, those emotions had long settled.
target: Nunc illi affectus iam diu sedaverant.

source: Of course, they had only settled, not disappeared.
target: Scilicet solum sedaverant, non evanuerant.

source: Lumian tore open the letter and jotted down the entire incident, planning to send it to Madam Magician at noon the next day.
target: Lumian epistolam laceravit et totum incidentem consignavit, disponens eam cras meridie ad Dominam Magicam mittere.

source: As for whether the Major Arcana card holder would agree to such an unequal trade, Lumian wasn’t too confident.
target: Quoad utrum possessor cartae Arcanae Maioris talem inaequabilem permutationem acciperet, Lumian non satis confidit.

source: However, he intuitively felt that the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana holders wouldn’t simply take possession of important artifacts from the orthodox Churches.
target: Tamen intuitim sensit quod possessorēs cartārum Arcanae Maioris Club Tarot non simpliciter res maximi momenti ex Ecclesiis orthodoxis acciperent.

source: Using this opportunity to make a deal was more likely.
target: Hoc opportunitate ad commercium faciendum uti, verisimilius videbatur.

source: After leaving the Brieu Motel, Lumian calmly observed Camus, donned in a yellow vest, emerge from a dimly lit street corner.
target: Postquam Brieu Motel discessit, Lumian tranquille observavit Camum, indutum in vestem flavam, ex obscuro angulo plateae emergentem.

source: Beside him was Rhea, a member of the local patrol wearing leather armor and carrying a hunting bow.
target: Iuxta eum erat Rhea, membrum vigiliarum localium, induta armatura coriacea et arcum venaticum gerens.

source: “Why two people today?” Lumian chuckled and strode towards Hisoka’s house.
target: “Cur duo homines hodie?” Lumian subridens dixit et ad domum Hisoka procedens accessit.

source: Camus took a deep breath to calm his sudden surge of emotions.
target: Camus altum spiritum traxit ad sedandum repentinum motum affectuum.

source: As he followed Louis Berry’s left hand, he replied in a deep voice, “There are only a few days left until the 17th.
target: Dum sequebatur manum sinistram Ludovici Berry, respondit voce profunda: “Paucis tantum diebus ad diem septendecimum restant.”

source: An accident might happen at any moment.
target: Casus quovis momento evenire potest.

source: We can’t act alone anymore.
target: Non iam soli agere possumus.

source: Having consciously gathered various information, the patrol team had already noticed some abnormalities.
target: Variis notitiis collectis, turma vigiliarum iam aliquas irregularitates animadvertit.

source: This made Camus feel that staying in Tizamo was unwise.
target: Id faciens Camum fecit sentire manere in Tizamo esse imprudentem.

source: He was constantly on edge.
target: Semper in tensione erat.

source: He felt a growing sense of being a middle-aged man burdened with heavy responsibilities.
target: Sensi crescere sensum se esse virum mediocris aetatis, gravibus oneri responsabilitatibus oneratum.

source: Raising an eyebrow, Lumian queried, “Hey, you figuring out the 17th is a key date was pretty fast.”
target: Supercilium levans, Lumian quaesivit: “Heus, celeriter animadvertisti diem septendecimum esse diem maximi momenti?”

source: “We’re not fools,” Camus finally couldn’t help but reply.
target: “Non sumus stulti,” Camus denique respondit.

source: “It’s an obvious issue.
target: “Manifestum est.”

source: Last year, Tizamo was attacked on December 17th, and in previous years…
target: Anno praeterito, Tizamo die XVII Decembris aggressum est, et in annis praeteritis…

source: At this point, he fell silent.
target: In hoc puncto siluit.

source: He realized that when around Louis Berry, he constantly switched between his heavy middle-aged state and uncontrollable teenage emotions.
target: Intellegebat, cum apud Ludovicum Berry esset, se constanter inter gravem statum medii aetatis et impetuosos affectus iuventutis alternare.

source: Lumian asked with interest, “What happened in previous years?”
target: Lumian studiose rogavit: “Quid accidit in annis praeteritis?”

source: Camus fell silent for a few seconds before saying, “We obtained the funeral registrations for nearly three decades in Tizamo from the Saint-Sien Cathedral and discovered a peculiar phenomenon.
target: Camus paucis momentis siluit antequam dixerit: “Funeris inscriptiones pro fere tribus decenniis in Tizamo ex cathedrali Sancti-Sien obtinuimus et phaenomenon singulare deteximus.”

source: 80% of the annual deaths are recorded within the first three months starting mid-December.
target: LXXX% mortuorum annuarum in tribus primis mensibus, incipiens a media Decembri, registrantur.

source: “This place isn’t like many Northern Continent places.
target: “Hic locus non est sicut multa loca in Continenti Septentrionali.”

source: “Winters are bitterly cold there.
target: Hiems ibi acerbum est.

source: It’s difficult for the elderly and weak to survive.
target: Senibus atque infirmis superesse difficile est.

source: Even if they do, it’s summer from late December to late March.
target: Etiam, si superesse afferant, aestus viget a fine Decembris ad finem Martii.

source: This phenomenon is abnormal.
target: Hoc phaenomenon insolitum est.

source: Lumian advanced slowly and nodded slightly.
target: Lumian lente processit et leviter annuit.

source: “Is the mortality rate in Tizamo higher than elsewhere?”
target: “Num in Tizamo mortalitas altior est quam alibi?”

source: “Significantly higher, but that’s mainly due to attacks from the primitive forest tribe.
target: “Significanter altior, sed hoc praecipue propter impetus a tribu silvestri primitivae est.”

source: Also, we discovered the tribe’s attacks concentrated in the three months beginning mid-December.
target: Etiam deteximus impetus tribus in tribus mensibus, incipiens a media Decembri, concentratos esse.

source: There have been two to three attacks annually, and since the one on December 17th last year, not a single one has occurred.
target: Duo vel tria impetus quotannis fuerunt, et post eum die XVII Decembris anni praeteriti, nullus evenit.

source: The situation doesn’t seem right.
target: Res non recte videtur.

source: Camus was a little worried a major attack would occur in the next few days.
target: Camus paululum sollicitus erat ne impetus major in proximis diebus eveniret.

source: “Heh heh, it’s understandable the tribe’s attacks concentrated in those first three months.
target: “Heh heh, intellegibile est impetus tribus in illis primis tribus mensibus concentrari.

source: Any other abnormalities?” Lumian asked casually.
target: “Aliae irregularitates sunt?” Lumian leviter interrogavit.

source: Rhea, who had been silently following, responded.
target: Rhea, quae silentio secuta erat, respondit.

source: The brown-skinned, brown-haired woman, exuding a wild beauty, spoke in a raspy voice,
target: Mulier fusca cute et capillis fusco, feram pulchritudinem effundens, voce rauca locuta est,

source: “In the first half of this year, many women in town and the plantations experienced symptoms of nausea, soreness, bloating—pregnancy symptoms.
target: “In prima dimidia huius anni, multae feminae in urbe et in plantis nausea, dolorem, tumorem—signa graviditatis—passae sunt.

source: They believed they’d been victimized by a ghost and might birth evil fetuses, but they weren’t actually pregnant.
target: Credebant se a phantasma laesos esse et malos fetos pariturum esse, sed re vera non gravidabantur.

source: Just illusions.
target: Illusiones tantum erant.

source: After Padre Cali held Mass and briefly purified them, they received psychological comfort and quickly returned to normal.
target: Postquam Padre Cali Missam egit et breviter eos purgavit, solacium animi acceperunt et celeriter ad statum pristinum redierunt.

source: “We’ve also noticed similar incidents of perceived possession and attacks by evil spirits in Tizamo over the years, concentrated in that first half.
target: “Etiam animadvertimus similes casus possessionis perceptae et impetus ab spiritibus malis in Tizamo per annos, in illa prima dimidia concentratos.

source: “It’s not just pregnancy symptoms,” Camus added.
target: “Non tantum signa graviditatis,” Camus addidit.

source: Lumian halted in his tracks.
target: Lumian in cursu suo cessavit.

source: “Don’t the townsfolk and the people in the surrounding plantations find it strange that mass hysteria occurs every year?”
target: “Num incolae urbis et homines in agris circumstantibus non mirantur quod massa tumultus quotannis eveniat?”

source: As a member of the local patrol team, Rhea explained simply, “Everyone believes it’s caused by the primitive tribe in the forest.”
target: Ut membrum cohortis vigiliarum localium, Rhea simpliciter explicavit: “Omnes credunt id tribu silvestri primitivae regionis causari.”

source: “Why?” Lumian resumed his nocturnal “stroll.”
target: “Cur?” Lumian, nocturnam ambulandi viam iterum suscipiens, rogavit.

source: Rhea’s vocal cords seemed damaged, and her voice was always a little hoarse.
target: Rheae chordae vocales laesi videbantur, et vox eius paulum semper rauca erat.

source: “In the repeated attacks and conflicts, the primitive tribe displayed the ability to control corpses, ghosts, and shadows.
target: “In impetus et conflictibus repetitis, tribus primitiva ostendit facultatem cadavera, phantasma, et umbras regere.

source: Furthermore, some warriors seemed to continue protecting their tribe in their spirit form after their deaths.
target: Praeterea, quidam bellatores videbantur tribum suam, post mortem, in forma spiritus protegere.

source: Death domain… Heh, the entire matter seems logical on the surface.
target: Regio mortis… Heh, tota quaestio in superficie logica videtur.

source: No wonder the Tizamons who left town didn’t find anything amiss and didn’t raise the issue…
target: Non mirum est quod Tizamones, qui urbem reliquerunt, nihil amissum reperirent nec de re loquerentur.

source: Lumian had seen records of the primitive tribe, but they weren’t as specific as Rhea’s description.
target: Lumian documenta de tribu primitiva viderat, sed non erant tam specifica quam Rheae descriptio.

source: After inquiring about the recent information the patrol team had gathered, Lumian stopped in front of Hisoka’s house and turned to glance at Rhea, who was carrying a hunting bow and arrows.
target: Postquam de novis notitiis quas turma vigiliarum collegerat inquisivit, Lumian coram domo Hisoka cessit et adspicere conversus est ad Rhea, quae arcum venaticum et sagittas gerebat.

source: “You’re from the Southern Continent, but not from Tizamo?”
target: “Ex Continente Meridionali es, sed non ex Tizamo?”

source: Rhea nodded and calmly said, “I’m from the forest.
target: Rhea annuens tranquillime respondit: “Ex silva sum.”

source: I’m from one of the primitive tribes called Paca.
target: Ex una tribu primitiva, quae Paca vocatur, sum.

source: We mainly live near the Paz Valley.
target: Praesertim prope Vallis Paz habitamus.

source: The rainforest of the Southern Continent spanned a vast expanse, encompassing numerous territories.
target: Foresta pluvialis Continenti Meridionalis immensa extensio est, compluribus terris includens.

source: From the area near the Paz Valley to the vicinity of Matani, the distance might be even greater than that between Cordu and Trier.
target: A regione prope Vallis Paz ad prope Matani, distantia fortasse maior est quam inter Cordu et Trier.

source: “Paca” meant “wind” in Dutanese.
target: “Paca” significabat “ventum” in lingua Dutana.

source: “How did you come to Matani?” Lumian asked curiously.
target: “Quomodo ad Matani pervenisti?” Lumian curiosus rogavit.

source: Rhea let out a chuckle.
target: Rhea subridens eduxit risum.

source: “I was sold here.”
target: “Hic vendita sum.”

source: She paused for a moment before continuing, “Ten years ago, my tribe was attacked by the Loen Kingdom’s army.
target: Paulisper cessavit antequam pergeret: “Decem abhinc annos, tribus mea a exercitu Regni Loen aggressa est.

source: I was captured and sold repeatedly before arriving in the Northern state.
target: Capta fui et pluries vendita, antequam ad statum Septentrionalem pervenirem.

source: Later, I found a chance to escape and fled to Port Pylos.
target: Postea, occasionem evadendi inveni et ad Portum Pylos confugi.

source: I received help from the Church and found work.
target: Auxilium a Ecclesia accepi et laborem inveni.

source: Eventually, I was lucky enough to become a Beyonder.
target: Denique, fortunata, Beyonder facta sum.

source: The patrol team member calmly recounted her past, not dwelling on any pain or torture from those experiences, nor deliberately avoiding details.
target: Membrum turmae vigiliarum tranquille praeterita sua enarrare coepit, neque dolorem aut cruciatum ex illis experimentis detinuit nec singularia omisit.

source: No wonder you believe so devoutly in the Eternal Blazing Sun…
target: Non mirum est quod tam devote Solem Aeternum Flammantem credas…

source: Lumian ascended the stairs to the second floor and said in an even tone, “Did you keep using a bow instead of firearms out of habit?”
target: Lumian scalam in secundarium gradum ascendit et aequo toni dixit: “Num ex consuetudine arcum usus es potius quam arma ignifera?”

source: “Yes. Tribes named for the wind excel at archery.” Rhea’s light-brown face softened.
target: “Ita est. Tribus, quae vento nominatae sunt, in arcubus excellunt.” Facies Rhea, levis et castanea, leniter mollita est.

source: Lumian glanced back at her.
target: Lumian ad eam iterum respexit.

source: “Did you ever go back to take a look?”
target: “Num umquam rediit ut rem inspiceret?”

source: Rhea fell silent for a few seconds.
target: Rhea paucis momentis siluit.

source: “They’re all dead…”
target: “Omnes mortui sunt…”

source: Lumian and Camus retreated their gazes in silence as they climbed the final stairs and entered the second floor of the house.
target: Lumian et Camus silentio oculos retraxerunt, dum ultimas scalas ascendebant et in secundarium domus gradum intraverunt.

source: Lumian surveyed the spacious yet rudimentary surroundings, listening to the wild roars from the primitive forest.
target: Lumian spatia ampla sed rudia perspexit, auscultans feroces clamores ex silva primitiva.

source: He sat cross-legged.
target: Sedit cruribus transpositis.

source: He had intended to tell Rhea, “It’s impossible for your entire tribe to be wiped out.
target: Voluerat Rhea dicere: “Impossibile est totam tuam tribum exterminari.”

source: Some must have been captured and sold like you.
target: Nonnulli certē capti et venditi sunt sicut tu.

source: They could still be alive on plantations, in mines, or seedy bars.
target: Fortasse adhuc vivunt in plantis, in fodinis, aut in popinis spurcissimis.

source: But he held back.
target: Sed retinuit.

source: He could tell Rhea had accepted her current life and gained the ability to live better.
target: Intellegebat Rhea vitam suam praesentem accepisse et facultatem melius vivendi adeptam esse.

source: It seemed inappropriate to encourage her to risk traversing both continents seeking potential remaining clansmen.
target: Videbatur inopportunum eam incitare ut per utramque continentem iter faceret ad quaerendos, qui fortasse adhuc superessent de genere suo.

source: Just the thought of such an endeavor was daunting.
target: Mere cogitatio talis conatus formidolosus videbatur.

source: With so few clues and them likely scattered far, it could prove quite dangerous.
target: Cum tam paucis signis et verisimiliter longe disseminatis, id se valde periculosum ostendere poterat.

source: Even spending a lifetime, one might never complete it.
target: Etiam, totam vitam impendens, id fortasse numquam conficietur.

source: Not everyone with a similar experience would sacrifice a normal life for vengeance or seeking others.
target: Non omnes, similem experientiam habentes, vitam normam pro ultione aut alios quaerendo sacrificant.

source: Rhea likely realized some clansmen survived, but perhaps those most important to her had perished.
target: Rhea probabiliter intellexit aliquos membra gentis superesse, sed fortasse illos, qui maxime ei erant, perisse.

source: She chose to stay in Port Pylos.
target: Optavit manere in Portu Pylos.

source: Everyone makes their own choices.
target: Omnes suas electiones faciunt.

source: I can’t ask the same of others just because of my own obsessions…
target: Non possum aliis eundem postulari, propter meas solas obsessiones.

source: Lumian composed himself and smiled at Camus and Rhea, who were still standing.
target: Lumian se composuit et Camum ac Rheam subridens respexit, qui adhuc stabant.

source: “Would you like to explore the potential venue for the Dream Festival?”
target: “Visne explorare locum potentialem pro Festivitate Somniorum?”

source: “Where?” Rhea blurted out.
target: “Ubi?” exclamavit Rhea.

source: Camus furrowed his brow.
target: Camus supercilia contraxit.

source: “Here?”
target: “Hic?”

source: Quickly making a guess, he asked, “Do you come here every night to sleep and access the Dream Festival’s location? Is it in a special dream?”
target: Celeriter coniectans, quaesivit: “Venisne hic omni nocte ut dormias et ad locum Festi Somniorum pervenias? Estne in somnio speciali?”

source: Quite smart… Lumian praised Camus inwardly for his quick thinking, but his smile remained unwavering.
target: Callide… Lumian Camum interno animo laudavit propter celerrimam cogitationem, sed risus eius immotus permanebat.

source: “Care to experience it?”
target: “Visne id experiri?”

source: Camus and Rhea exchanged glances and agreed, “I’ll experience it. Rhea, keep an eye on the surroundings.”
target: Camus et Rhea oculos commutaverunt et consenserunt: “Experiar. Rhea, circumiecta vigila.”

source: “I can set some traps,” Lumian offered.
target: “Laqueos imponere possum,” Lumian obtulit.

source: He stood up and spent a few minutes setting up warning traps nearby.
target: Surgens, paucis minutis laqueos admonitores prope instituere conatus est.

source: Afterward, he lit a mosquito repellent candle, placing it in the middle of the spacious second floor.
target: Postea, candelam culicos repellentem accendit, eam in medio secundi pavimenti spatiosi posuit.

source: Mosquitoes that hadn’t flown away landed on the ground, emitting flames and smoke amidst crackling sounds.
target: Culices, qui nondum volaverant, in terram se deposuerunt, flammas et fumum emittens inter sonos crepitantes.

source: “Sleep here,” Lumian instructed Camus and Rhea as he sat cross-legged again.
target: “Hic dormite,” Lumian Camum et Rheam iussit, dum iterum cruribus transpositis sedit.

source: He had confirmed that sleeping anywhere in Hisoka’s house at night allowed him to enter the special dream.
target: Confirmavit se quod ubique in domo Hisoka nocte dormire licebat, ita ut in somnium speciale perveniret.

source: Sleeping outside or sleeping two hours earlier didn’t have the same effect.
target: Extra domum dormire aut duas horas ante non eundem effectum habebat.

source: Perplexed, Camus and Rhea found seats and leaned against different wooden pillars, attempting to enter a deep slumber.
target: Perturbati, Camus et Rhea sedes quaesierunt et contra diversas columnas ligneas se reclinaverunt, conantes in profundum soporem pervenire.

source: After an unknown period of time, Camus suddenly woke up.
target: Post aliquod ignotum tempus, Camus subito evigilavit.

source: Before him was the night and the crimson moonlight outside the window.
target: Ante eum nox erat et rufum lunam lumen extra fenestram fulgebat.

source: Louis Berry stood behind the flickering mosquito repellent candle, wearing a golden straw hat.
target: Ludovicus Berry stabat post candelam culicos repellentem micantem, pileum stramineum aureum gerens.

source: The adventurer playfully remarked, “Welcome to the Dream Festival.”
target: Aventurator ludenter dixit: “Salve ad Festum Somniorum!”
